abilities.name: Votive Incense
abilities.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to 1% of Lingsha's ATK to a single target enemy.

abilities.name: Smoke and Splendor
abilities.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to 0.8% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies and at the same time, restores HP equal to 0.14% of Lingsha's ATK plus 420 for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by 0.2%.

abilities.name: Dripping Mistscape
abilities.text:
Inflicts "Befog" on all enemies. While in "Befog," targets receive 0.25% increased Break DMG, lasting for 2 turn(s).
Deals Fire DMG equal to 1.5% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies, and at the same time restores HP equal to 0.12% of Lingsha's ATK plus 360 for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by 1%.

abilities.name: Mistdance Manifest
abilities.text:
When using Skill, summons Fuyuan, with an initial SPD of 90 and an initial action count of 3.
When taking action, Fuyuan launches follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 0.75% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Fire DMG equal to 0.75% of Lingsha's ATK to a single random enemy, and this DMG prioritizes targets that have both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness. Dispels 1 debuff(s) from all allies and restores HP equal to 0.12% of Lingsha's ATK plus 360.
Fuyuan's action count can accumulate up to 5. When the action count reaches 0 or when Lingsha is knocked down, Fuyuan disappears.
While Fuyuan is on the field, using Skill can increase Fuyuan's action count by 3.

abilities.name: Wisps of Aurora
abilities.text: After using Technique, immediately summons Fuyuan at the start of the next battle and inflicts "Befog" on all enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Vermilion Waft
abilities.desc: Increases this unit's ATK or Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to 25%/10% of Break Effect, up to a maximum increase of 50%/20% respectively.

abilities.name: Sylvan Smoke
abilities.desc: When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates 10 Energy.

abilities.name: Ember's Echo
abilities.desc: When Fuyuan is on the field and any ally character takes DMG or consumes HP, if a character in the team has their current HP percentage lower than or equal to 60%, Fuyuan will immediately launch the Talent's follow-up attack. This does not consume Fuyuan's action count. This effect can trigger again after 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Bloom on Vileward Bouquet
abilities.desc: Lingsha's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 50%. When an enemy unit's Weakness is Broken, reduces their DEF by 20%.

abilities.name: Leisure in Carmine Smokeveil
abilities.desc: When using Ultimate, increases all allies' Break Effect by 40%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

abilities.name: Shine of Floral Wick
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Redolence from Canopied Banquet
abilities.desc: When Fuyuan takes action, restores HP equal to 40% of Lingsha's ATK for the ally whose current HP is the lowest.

abilities.name: Poise Atop Twists and Turns
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Arcadia Under Deep Seclusion
abilities.desc: While Fuyuan is on the field, reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. When Fuyuan attacks, additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing both Fire DMG equal to 50% of Lingsha's ATK and a Toughness Reduction of 5 to a single random enemy. This prioritizes targets with both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness.
